label: Proteomic signatures in cerebrospinal fluid and their clinical associations in patients with ME/CFS.
summary: This study evaluated the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) proteomes from 31 patients diagnosed with myalgic encephalomyelitis/chronic fatigue syndrome (ME/CFS). We quantified 902 proteins, each expressed in at least eleven samples, and systematically categorized clinical factors relevant to ME/CFS symptoms-including autonomic dysfunction, neuroinflammation and metabolic disturbances.
